safety_gaps: Reservation enumeration uses systemctl --user list-units --type=service only; active .scope units may be omitted from aggregate cap accounting.

Subprocess uses start_new_session=True. Timeout/OOM cleanup kills discovered descendants, but there is no finally/signal handler around the post-Popen region; KeyboardInterrupt or another Python exception can leave compiler descendants running.

600-second inactivity gate checks stdout and output target growth; GNU time wraps rustup (not rustc directly), so GNU RSS is process accounting as reported by time, while cgroup samples are the aggregate scope measurement.
